integrity: The proof is a self-contained carry/digit partition with a primitive-substitution frequency argument; finite numerical checks are corroborative, not the source of infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The exact count concerns adjacent 01 pairs on ternary-all-ones prefix boundaries only; the general discrepancy envelope and other base/modulus pairs are not determined. The 01 frequency is known in earlier factor-frequency literature. Independent validation and complete priority verification remain outstanding.
title: Exact repunit-prefix bigram discrepancy in the ternary digit-sum word
